issue: `VyperSqrt.sqrt` is a port of the code the Vyper compiler inlines for the builtin `sqrt(d: decimal) -> decimal` (a Babylonian loop of at most 256 iterations on decimals, raw values scaled by 10^10). On the decimal 0.9999999998 (raw 9999999998) it returns 0.9999999999 (raw 9999999999), although the square root of 0.9999999998 is 0.999999999899999999995 (rounded), so the result is above the root. Applications use `sqrt()` to determine boundary conditions, so a result that is sometimes rounded up and sometimes down is a problem: the result must be the root rounded down to the nearest 10^-10.

source.function: class Sqrt in vyper/builtins/functions.py; decimal arithmetic in vyper/codegen/arithmetic.py (safe_add, safe_div) and clamps in vyper/codegen/core.py

buggy.note: released 2024-06-20; GHSA-2p94-8669-xg86 (CVE-2025-26622), published 2025-02-21, affects versions below 0.4.1
